t: The LAP Gavy outdoor LED solar-powered spike light is a reliable ground-mounted lighting solution designed to illuminate pathways and garden borders. This pack of 6 durable stainless steel and plastic fixtures is ideal for domestic landscapers and homeowners looking to enhance garden safety and night time visibility. Each IP65-rated light delivers a cool white light of 3 lumens, powered entirely by solar energy with included AAA batteries. The integrated LEDs offer up to 15,000 hours of life, providing a low-maintenance, fixed-position lighting system that easily pushes into the soil using the sturdy ground spikes.
b: Sharp Ground Spikes Allow Quick & Easy Installation
